rules.statement: Don't report long lines in Markdown or MDX docs as a wrap-width violation unless one of the repository's instruction files (AGENTS.md and the files it lists, .github/instructions, .claude/rules, .editorconfig, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs README) sets a wrap width.
rules.why: The maintainer declined a finding that cited a 120-column wrap rule that no instruction set. The existing docs already had many lines past 120 columns.
rules.check: Before raising a line-length finding on docs, find the written instruction that sets the width. If there isn't one, or the PR's plan allows long lines, don't report it.

rules.statement: In MDX, don't suggest moving an inline JSX component tag that continues a paragraph onto its own line starting at column 0, and don't suggest splitting a row of component tags across lines.
rules.why: In MDX, a line that starts at column 0 with a component tag becomes a separate block, not part of the paragraph. This closes the paragraph and changes the rendering and the CSS that applies, for example adding a stray label.
rules.check: When a suggested rewrap would put a `<Component … />` tag at the start of a line in an MDX file, check whether that turns the tag into its own block. If it does, don't suggest the rewrap.
